function.name: list_external_url
function.description: List external URLs from current site. Supports optional keyword, resource type, skip, and take filters.

keyword.description: Optional keyword used to match external URL text

resourceType.description: Optional resource type. Accepts numeric type id or type name like Image, Script, Style

skip.description: Optional number of items to skip from the beginning

take.description: Optional maximum number of items to return. Default is 50

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
